title: Field permissions
description: Choose, per role, which {{recordType}} fields are hidden, read-only or editable. The rule applies across the app, the API, exports and webhooks.

legend.title: How it works
legend.hidden: Hidden: the field disappears from lists, forms, filters, exports and webhooks; filtering or sorting by it is refused.
legend.read_only: Read-only: the field is shown but cannot be changed (not even by imports or bulk actions).
legend.locked: Required and structural fields (name, title, owner, system dates, pipeline, stage and status) are always editable.
legend.admin: The Administrator role always edits every field.

table.caption: Access to {{recordType}} fields per role
table.applyToColumnLabel: Apply to every field of the {{role}} role

noRoles: There are no configurable roles besides Administrator. Create roles under Roles to restrict fields.

confirm.title: Save field permissions?
confirm.description_one: {{count}} cell will change. Users of the affected roles see and edit the fields under the new rule right away, including through the API and webhooks.

errors.locked: One or more fields cannot be restricted.
